name: Chicken Marsala or Piccata (Strained Savory Gravy)
whyItWorks: Thinly pounded chicken cutlets dredged in white flour and pan-seared in butter and broth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Use mushroom powder or strain the gravy to get rich umami flavor without rubbery, indigestible whole mushroom pieces or capers. Serve over angel hair pasta or mashed potatoes.
